snippet.title: WoofWatch – Mech Dog Roguelite Gameplay Trailer (Demo)
snippet.description:
Check out the official demo trailer for WoofWatch, a fast-paced action roguelite where mech-suited dogs battle through procedurally shifting districts of Pastel City.

Dodge, shoot, and stack wild weapon and armor effects to survive chaotic runs and take down bosses inspired by canine fears.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458330/WoofWatch/

Website: https://woofwatchgame.com/

Follow development:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/woofwatchgame/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Z8zm9Nqh93
X: https://x.com/woofwatchgame
